Fills a scene with what everything is at right now: the volume of every bus and every listener setting. Applying it later brings all of it back. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
saved = CreateAudioScene()
CaptureAudioScene saved
ApplyAudioScene cutscene, 500
; ... the cutscene ...
ApplyAudioScene saved, 500
```
@param scene  A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error.
@gap What the scene held before is forgotten.
